name: @driftbox/rack
description: A modular synth rack: modules, cables between any of them, one graph at sample rate in a single AudioWorklet.
author: Louis Emmett
//private: Not published yet. This is the spine — a compiler, three modules and a worklet host — and a version on npm is a promise about an API that has not been used by a UI even once. Drop this and add publishConfig.access when the rack can be patched.
//dependencies: Narrowly, and only for DSP. The ladder module wraps the engine's `Ladder` rather than copying it: the engine's README says two copies of a synthesis engine would diverge, and a rack whose filter has drifted from the drum machines' filter is exactly that. Nothing else is imported, and the engine is sideEffects:false, so a bundler drops the sequencer and the songs.
